exposure.needed: whether external dashboards, alerts or recording rules query the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout

original.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Envoy metric `envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_init_fetch_timeout` is renamed to `envoy_cilium_npds_init_fetch_timeout`, so monitoring that queries the old name needs to be checked.

decision.reason: [ev-3c947c36df35] and [ev-77f05428497a] list only a metric rename (the Envoy NPDS metric prefix changed from envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_ to envoy_cilium_npds_). They name no setting, flag, values key, field or ConfigMap key that controls exposure. Whether an environment is affected depends on whether outside metric consumers (dashboards, alerts, recording rules) still query the old name, which no release-level configuration predicate reads. An undecidable leaf naming exactly that dependency is a reasonable exposure condition and is neither broader nor narrower than the evidence supports.
